about_pullquote: We built this on respect: treat every home like it's our own.
about_para_1: Magic Broom started over eight years ago in Selly Oak when I realised too many cleaning companies weren't listening to what their customers actually wanted. I began with a van, a mop, and a promise to show up on time and do the job right. Today we've grown to serve hundreds of Birmingham homes and businesses, but we still treat each one as if it were the first.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we're reliable, thorough, and genuinely friendly. We don't use high-pressure sales tactics or lock you into long contracts. If you're happy, you'll tell your neighbours—and they do. That's how we've built our reputation across Selly Oak, Harborne, Edgbaston, and beyond.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: I've had Magic Broom clean my house every two weeks for three years now. They're reliable, friendly, and my place always looks amazing. Sarah and the team are fantastic. Wouldn't use anyone else.

reviews.text: Needed a deep clean before selling. Gave them a call on the Friday, they came out Monday morning and absolutely transformed the place. Even got the windows done without asking. Fair price too.

reviews.text: Our office gets cleaned every week and it's never once been less than perfect. They work around our hours and never make a fuss. Proper professional outfit.
